svg.title: The journey of one CBTC payment
svg.desc: Five lanes: payee, payer, CBTC registry, Canton ledger and the payee's ledger view. Step 4: the payee reads CBTC's identity and decimals from the registry. Step 5: the payee creates the request as a link or QR. Step 6: the payer verifies it on payvol.xyz/app/verify. Step 7: from payvol.xyz/app/pay, the wallet gets the transfer factory from the registry and the payer reviews and signs one TransferFactory_Transfer, which the ledger records with the reference as reason. Step 8: the payee matches the payment to the invoice by its reference.
